## 文化依据与风险

- [新华网：千城百县看中国·传承｜伏里土陶](https://app.xinhuanet.com/news/article.html?articleId=440938ab6a1791ef4c6ce4b0c1ea9a92)：支持枣庄山亭伏里土陶、泥料及手工塑形文化背景，不证明生成器物的身份。

原创圆腹陶器、陶坊、纹理和场景，不对应具体作者作品或真实场所。以下风险仍需实际遮罩检查：
- 罐口、肩部与底足可能跨越市域边缘或凹口，需检查实际遮罩；不可因图大而移动边界。
- 两版均是同一类圆腹器物，材质与小尺度色块差异仍需整图判断。
- 标签覆盖、邻区配色、手机尺度尚待原SVG实拼验证。
- 数据的行政边界、地图审定与公开许可尚待核实。

## 实际完整提示词

### A 水墨
Use case: stylized-concept. One complete square Zaozhuang cultural artwork for an internal experimental Shandong map. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the real Zaozhuang composition template, not visual content to copy. The entire square reference and its margins maps to the entire output square at the same position and proportions, no crop/zoom/rotation/distortion. A separate precise vector mask will later cut this artwork; do not depict, trace, preserve or bake in its geographical outline, flat fill, beige margin, guide colors, or map shape. Paint an uninterrupted full-bleed square, natural texture across all edges.

One protagonist: an original imagined rounded, broad-shouldered clay vessel inspired by Fuli earthenware traditions in Zaozhuang. Its handmade clay body and recognizable mouth / shoulders are a large simple coherent shape, and its visual core belongs near x=0.573, y=0.462 of the full reference canvas, within the broad main interior rather than the narrow ends. The entire pot may expand beyond the conservative core, but keep the rim and key body away from the outline's sharp notches; do not depend on minute inscription or thin handles. A subtle imagined pottery workshop or forming gesture may support the object but cannot compete. Invent the object and scene: it is not an existing artifact, historical reconstruction, actual person's work or real location. No writing, numbers, marks, seals, signatures, labels, watermark, UI, geographic outline or frame. Style A: hand-painted Chinese ink wash on visibly fibrous paper, earthy burnt sienna and restrained smoky ink, confident warm clay-colored brush forms contrasted with airy lighter strokes. The handmade pot dominates while imagined pottery atmosphere is soft and subordinate. Not a photo or shop catalog.

### B 工艺融合
Use case: stylized-concept. One complete square Zaozhuang cultural artwork for an internal experimental Shandong map. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the real Zaozhuang composition template, not visual content to copy. The entire square reference and its margins maps to the entire output square at the same position and proportions, no crop/zoom/rotation/distortion. A separate precise vector mask will later cut this artwork; do not depict, trace, preserve or bake in its geographical outline, flat fill, beige margin, guide colors, or map shape. Paint an uninterrupted full-bleed square, natural texture across all edges.

One protagonist: an original imagined rounded, broad-shouldered clay vessel inspired by Fuli earthenware traditions in Zaozhuang. Its handmade clay body and recognizable mouth / shoulders are a large simple coherent shape, and its visual core belongs near x=0.573, y=0.462 of the full reference canvas, within the broad main interior rather than the narrow ends. The entire pot may expand beyond the conservative core, but keep the rim and key body away from the outline's sharp notches; do not depend on minute inscription or thin handles. A subtle imagined pottery workshop or forming gesture may support the object but cannot compete. Invent the object and scene: it is not an existing artifact, historical reconstruction, actual person's work or real location. No writing, numbers, marks, seals, signatures, labels, watermark, UI, geographic outline or frame. Style B: an original handcrafted earthenware art interpretation with tactile natural red-brown clay, visible grains, handmade forming marks and understated impressed / incised patterns; soft parchment, muted charcoal and warm earth textures arranged as a refined material-based composition. Avoid polished CGI and avoid copying a specific existing pottery piece.
